verdict.rationale: Fly.io's `fly launch` workflow creates, configures, and deploys an app from a single project directory (fly-io-docs-16, fly-io-docs-1), and `fly machine run` further shows one-line create+deploy semantics (fly-io-docs-27), implying a single fly.toml-style config drives the whole architecture. However the evidence never explicitly names or documents the fly.toml config schema, nor shows how that file is versioned/rolled back (the 'roll back to any checkpoint' claim, fly-io-docs-9, refers to Sprite/agent checkpoints, not app config versioning), and 'fly scale' (fly-io-docs-24) is a separate CLI action rather than config-driven scaling. Missing for 10: explicit fly.toml schema/documentation, config-file-based versioning or rollback, multi-service/region architecture defined in one file, independent hands-on confirmation.
